title: ὁ Ὑπερβρέφος σῴζει
learning_goal: Practice present-tense narration with first-person statements, simple imperatives (positive/negative), and clear vocatives marked with ὦ.
plot: Hyperbrephos hears Glaux and Panda in danger from Lukos, rushes out to save them by throwing a stone, and they happily play again.

objects: Bright red leather ball, palm-sized, perfectly round with a subtle stitched seam.
Broad low-branched oak-like shade tree with lush olive-green leaves and textured warm-brown bark.
positioning: Panda stands front-left of the tree on the cobblestone path, three-quarter view to camera, looking toward Glaux.
Glaux stands front-right of the tree, three-quarter left view, eyes on Panda.
Bright red leather ball, palm-sized, perfectly round with a subtle stitched seam lies centered between Panda and Glaux on the ground.
Broad low-branched oak-like shade tree with lush olive-green leaves and textured warm-brown bark anchors center background, trunk visible between the two friends.
motivations: Panda is cheerful and focused on playing catch with Glaux before any trouble appears.
Glaux is relaxed and happy, playing catch with Panda near the friendly tree.
frames.action: Panda and Glaux play with a red ball beneath the big shade tree near the cottage.
frames.artist_notes: FADE IN to a sunny, welcoming exterior. Keep the cottage tiny in the far background.
frames.camera_static: Wide establishing shot: the tree in the foreground dominates; the cottage sits far behind. Panda and Glaux are clearly visible with the ball between them.
frames.camera_movement: Hold static in a calm, storybook wide.

frames.text: ἐγώ νῦν βάλλω τὴν σφαῖραν, ὦ Γλαῦξ.
frames.speaker: Panda
objects: Bright red leather ball, palm-sized, perfectly round with a subtle stitched seam.
Broad low-branched oak-like shade tree with lush olive-green leaves and textured warm-brown bark.
positioning: Panda faces right toward Glaux in a medium two-shot, front three-quarter view, arm drawn back to throw, eyes on the ball.
Glaux faces left toward Panda, front three-quarter view, ready to receive, eyes on the ball.
Bright red leather ball, palm-sized, perfectly round with a subtle stitched seam is between their hands at chest height.
Broad low-branched oak-like shade tree with lush olive-green leaves and textured warm-brown bark fills background center-left.
motivations: Panda is excited to throw the ball to her friend Glaux during their game.
Glaux is attentive and ready to catch because Panda announced the throw.
frames.action: Panda announces she will throw the ball and tosses it toward Glaux.
frames.camera_static: Medium two-shot on Panda and Glaux facing each other with the ball between them.
frames.camera_movement: Very slight handheld energy as Panda starts the throw.

frames.speaker: Glaux
objects: Bright red leather ball, palm-sized, perfectly round with a subtle stitched seam.
Broad low-branched oak-like shade tree with lush olive-green leaves and textured warm-brown bark.
positioning: Glaux fills frame in a close view, front three-quarter, wings/arms forward, eyes tracking the incoming ball.
Bright red leather ball, palm-sized, perfectly round with a subtle stitched seam arcs into Glaux’s hands at chest level.
Broad low-branched oak-like shade tree with lush olive-green leaves and textured warm-brown bark is soft-focused in the background.
motivations: Glaux is concentrating to catch the ball that Panda just threw.
frames.action: Glaux catches the red ball and declares she is taking it.
frames.artist_notes: Begin close on the ball in flight, then include Glaux catching in the final framing.
frames.camera_static: Close on the ball mid-arc, shallow depth of field.
frames.camera_movement: Pan to follow the ball into Glaux’s catch, settling into a close shot on Glaux.

frames.text: ὁ Λύκος νῦν προσέρχεται πρὸς τὸ δένδρον.

Broad low-branched oak-like shade tree with lush olive-green leaves and textured warm-brown bark.
positioning: Lukos steps in from frame right, three-quarter left view, cautious and sly, eyes toward the tree area offscreen.
Bright red leather ball, palm-sized, perfectly round with a subtle stitched seam rests low in the foreground edge, partially cropped.
Broad low-branched oak-like shade tree with lush olive-green leaves and textured warm-brown bark stands midground left.
motivations: Lukos approaches the tree because he has noticed the smaller animals and is hungry and scheming.
frames.action: Lukos steps into view, approaching the tree where the others are playing.
frames.camera_static: Pan-right reveal ends on a medium single of Lukos entering the play space.
frames.camera_movement: Pan right from the catch area to frame Lukos in a one-shot.

frames.speaker: Lukos
objects: Bright red leather ball, palm-sized, perfectly round with a subtle stitched seam.
Broad low-branched oak-like shade tree with lush olive-green leaves and textured warm-brown bark.
positioning: Lukos in medium front three-quarter view, looming slightly toward camera, eyes narrowed toward the offscreen children.
Bright red leather ball, palm-sized, perfectly round with a subtle stitched seam lies near Lukos’s feet at frame edge.
Broad low-branched oak-like shade tree with lush olive-green leaves and textured warm-brown bark sits behind Lukos.
motivations: Lukos bluntly threatens because he is hungry and thinks he can intimidate them.
frames.action: Lukos declares he wants to eat them.
frames.camera_static: Medium single on Lukos, slightly low angle to make him imposing.
frames.camera_movement: Hold steady for his threatening line.

frames.speaker: Panda
objects: Bright red leather ball, palm-sized, perfectly round with a subtle stitched seam.
Broad low-branched oak-like shade tree with lush olive-green leaves and textured warm-brown bark.
positioning: Panda and Glaux in a tight two-shot, front view, huddled together left of frame, eyes wide looking offscreen toward Lukos.
Bright red leather ball, palm-sized, perfectly round with a subtle stitched seam is on the ground at their feet.
Broad low-branched oak-like shade tree with lush olive-green leaves and textured warm-brown bark fills the right background.
motivations: Panda is frightened because Lukos just said he wants to eat them.
Glaux is alarmed and protective, staying close to Panda after Lukos’s threat.
frames.action: Panda cries out in fear as she and Glaux recoil together.
frames.camera_static: Tight two-shot on the friends’ scared faces.
frames.camera_movement: Slight push-in to emphasize their fear.

frames.speaker: Glaux
objects: Bright red leather ball, palm-sized, perfectly round with a subtle stitched seam.
Broad low-branched oak-like shade tree with lush olive-green leaves and textured warm-brown bark.

Panda clings beside Glaux, front three-quarter, still looking anxious toward Lukos offscreen.
Bright red leather ball, palm-sized, perfectly round with a subtle stitched seam rests at their toes.
Broad low-branched oak-like shade tree with lush olive-green leaves and textured warm-brown bark fills midground.
motivations: Glaux calls Hyperbrephos because Lukos is threatening them and they need rescue.
Panda hopes Hyperbrephos will arrive to protect them from Lukos.
frames.action: Glaux calls out to Hyperbrephos to help them.
frames.camera_static: Medium two-shot; Glaux looking off toward the house, Panda toward danger.
frames.camera_movement: Hold as Glaux calls out.

objects: Ten small smooth wooden blocks in natural maple, assorted rectangular shapes.
positioning: Hyperbrephos sits center on the floor, front three-quarter view, smiling at a tall block tower before him.
Ten small smooth wooden blocks in natural maple, assorted rectangular shapes are stacked into a tower nearly as tall as Hyperbrephos.
motivations: Hyperbrephos is happily playing and unaware that Panda and Glaux are in danger.
frames.action: In his bedroom, Hyperbrephos plays with a tall tower of wooden blocks.
frames.artist_notes: CUT TO interior. Make the tower comically tall for a baby.
frames.camera_static: Close-up on Hyperbrephos with his block tower filling most of frame.
frames.camera_movement: Hold steady, cozy interior feel.

objects: Ten small smooth wooden blocks in natural maple, assorted rectangular shapes.
positioning: Hyperbrephos in center frame, front view, smashing downward with both hands; excited focus forward.
Ten small smooth wooden blocks in natural maple, assorted rectangular shapes explode outward midair around him.
motivations: Hyperbrephos is playing vigorously, showing super strength even in play.
frames.action: Hyperbrephos smashes the tower; blocks fly away with cartoonish speed.
frames.artist_notes: Add motion lines and playful starburst as blocks scatter.
frames.camera_static: Tight on Hyperbrephos and the tower at the moment of the smash.
frames.camera_movement: Fast snap-zoom to accentuate the impact, then slight recoil.

frames.text: ὦ Ὑπερβρέφος, βοήθει ἡμῖν. ὦ Ὑπερβρέφος, βοήθει ἡμῖν.
frames.speaker: Glaux
objects: Ten small smooth wooden blocks in natural maple, assorted rectangular shapes.
positioning: Hyperbrephos pauses mid-motion at the doorway, front three-quarter view, eyes wide toward the sound outside.
Glaux is not visible but her voice is implied from outside; include a subtle sound-direction cue toward the exterior.
Ten small smooth wooden blocks in natural maple, assorted rectangular shapes lie scattered across the floor.
motivations: Hyperbrephos becomes concerned because he hears Glaux urgently calling for help from outside.
Glaux repeats the plea because Lukos is threatening her and Panda.
frames.action: Hyperbrephos hears Glaux’s repeated call for help and looks concerned toward the door.
frames.artist_notes: Consider faint echo lines or small text glyphs by the open door to indicate distant calling.
frames.camera_static: Medium on Hyperbrephos at the room’s threshold, turned toward the open door.
frames.camera_movement: Slight rack focus from scattered blocks to Hyperbrephos’s alert face.

frames.text: ὁ Ὑπερβρέφος ἀκούει τὴν φωνὴν καὶ τρέχει ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας.
frames.speaker: Didaskalos
objects: Ten small smooth wooden blocks in natural maple, assorted rectangular shapes.
positioning: Hyperbrephos bolts toward camera and out the door, motion-blur at the legs, determined expression forward.
Ten small smooth wooden blocks in natural maple, assorted rectangular shapes remain scattered behind in the room.
motivations: Hyperbrephos sprints out because he has heard Glaux and Panda need help.
frames.action: Hyperbrephos dashes out of the room with cartoon super speed.
frames.artist_notes: Add speed streaks, a tiny dust puff at the doorway.
frames.camera_static: Camera framed on the doorway from inside the room, waiting for Hyperbrephos’s burst.
frames.camera_movement: Quick pan to follow as he zips out, ending on the open, empty doorway.

Panda is hopeful upon seeing their strong friend approaching.

frames.text: ὁ Ὑπερβρέφος λαμβάνει τὸν λίθον καὶ βάλλει τὸν λίθον πρὸς τὸν Λύκον.
frames.speaker: Didaskalos
objects: Bright red leather ball, palm-sized, perfectly round with a subtle stitched seam.
Broad low-branched oak-like shade tree with lush olive-green leaves and textured warm-brown bark.
Smooth palm-sized gray river stone, oval, slightly speckled.
positioning: Hyperbrephos at frame left, front three-quarter, crouched to grab then throw the stone, eyes locked on Lukos.
Lukos at frame right, three-quarter left view, eyes widening at the incoming throw.
Glaux stands near Panda mid-left, both watching the throw toward Lukos.
Panda stands beside Glaux, hands clasped, hopeful gaze at Hyperbrephos.
Bright red leather ball, palm-sized, perfectly round with a subtle stitched seam lies near Panda.
Broad low-branched oak-like shade tree with lush olive-green leaves and textured warm-brown bark stands behind them.
Smooth palm-sized gray river stone, oval, slightly speckled is in Hyperbrephos’s hand mid-throw and also shown as a motion blur toward Lukos.
motivations: Hyperbrephos acts decisively to protect his friends by throwing the stone.
Lukos is alarmed because the stone is flying toward him.
Glaux watches anxiously, hoping the throw will stop Lukos.
Panda is tense but trusting Hyperbrephos to save them.

frames.artist_notes: Show clear throw arc and motion blur on the stone.
frames.camera_static: Wide framing including thrower (left) and target (right).
frames.camera_movement: Quick pan following the stone from Hyperbrephos toward Lukos.

Hyperbrephos appears in background left, front three-quarter, arm still extended from the throw.
Glaux and Panda in background mid-left, reacting with surprise and relief.
Bright red leather ball, palm-sized, perfectly round with a subtle stitched seam lies by Panda’s foot.
Broad low-branched oak-like shade tree with lush olive-green leaves and textured warm-brown bark frames the midground.
Smooth palm-sized gray river stone, oval, slightly speckled is shown at the point of impact on Lukos’s head.
motivations: Lukos is stunned because the stone just hit him.
Hyperbrephos remains focused after the successful throw to ensure his friends are safe.
Glaux is relieved as the threat is being stopped.
Panda is hopeful now that Lukos is hurt and backing down.
frames.action: The stone strikes Lukos’s head with a comic impact as the others look on.
frames.artist_notes: Add circling cartoon stars and a comical bump beginning to rise on Lukos’s head.
frames.camera_static: Medium close on Lukos at the moment of impact.
frames.camera_movement: A tiny shake on impact, then hold.

Hyperbrephos in background left, hands on hips in a heroic stance, front three-quarter.
Glaux and Panda mid-left, beginning to relax, eyes on Lukos.
Bright red leather ball, palm-sized, perfectly round with a subtle stitched seam remains by Panda.
Broad low-branched oak-like shade tree with lush olive-green leaves and textured warm-brown bark fills midground.
Smooth palm-sized gray river stone, oval, slightly speckled bounces to the ground near Lukos.

Hyperbrephos stays vigilant to make sure the danger is over.
Glaux feels safer as Lukos falls.
Panda begins to calm knowing Hyperbrephos protected them.
frames.action: Lukos stiffens comically and topples backward onto the ground.
frames.artist_notes: Add a gentle thud puff as Lukos hits the ground.
frames.camera_static: Wider shot to show the full fall and the group’s positions.
frames.camera_movement: Tilt down slightly to follow Lukos to the ground.

frames.camera_static: Close on Hyperbrephos for the admonition, with Lukos blurred in the background.
frames.camera_movement: Hold steady to emphasize the warning.

objects: Bright red leather ball, palm-sized, perfectly round with a subtle stitched seam.
